authorization.basis: Supervising thread reviewed and approved this fixed batch under the user's project .env real-experiment authorization
authorization.scope: 4 cases, 7 turns, one process, <=63 provider attempts including failures, no reruns or sample expansion

stopOnExternalFailure: application model deadline or transport failure
SSE body error or EOF without DONE
process identity or frozen inputs/versions change

exposure.seen: Old failed screen wording in two fresh sessions
exposure.newWordings: Explicit SKU switch, pronoun follow-up, unknown SKU/follow-up, partial unknown area; all development diagnostics on exposed source families

secondPassGate: Only actual trace with rewrite and rewritten.retrieval/rerank/grader counts as observed. If absent, report not_observed; do not force grader output or add cases/reruns.
freezeBeforeExecution: Specific approval for all public/synthetic inputs and <=63 total provider attempts including failures
Successful CI for the implementation and verified 63-request local HTTP cap
Record final Git/source/data/suite hashes, image and active versions, actual .env model names, containerId/StartedAt/RestartCount; no secrets exported
Same process, consumers disabled, single-attempt SDK/AOP/JDK; no other chats, ingestion, probes, restart or scaling
adjudication: Keep all seven slots including failures and not-attempted results; never select only successful replies.
Check original query, effective product scope and every pass query/filter/rank/decision; distinguish routing, recall, rerank, validated grader decision, rewrite and final fact selection.
Compare all final claims and qualifications against current catalog and actual captured chunk paragraphs; exact citations alone are not semantic correctness.
Require no old Apple identity/source after Samsung switch and no source facts for unknown SKU or unresolved pronoun.
For partial area question, require supported display correction plus explicit insufficiency for square-mm quantity; source has no such number.
Record repeat outcomes individually, actual attempts and HTTP latency; unknown token/currency remains null; no independent-human accuracy claim.
